note: The general concept of data lineage and why it differs from ownership/systems-of-record governance is standard enterprise-architecture practice, not Salesforce-specific. Two specific Salesforce product claims were verified directly against Salesforce developer documentation: (1) standard Field History Tracking's 18-month guaranteed retention for orgs created after June 1, 2011, with Field Audit Trail (Salesforce Shield) extending retention via a deployed per-object HistoryRetentionPolicy; (2) Setup Audit Trail's scope (metadata/configuration changes, not field-level data values) and its 180-day coverage window, per the SetupAuditTrail object reference. No screenshot was used; this course's Chapter 3 is conceptual/architecture content taught through prose and tables, never UI click-paths.
